literal.prompt: Какой действующий вулкан расположен на острове Росса в Антарктиде?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt asks for the active volcano on Ross Island, Antarctica. Retained GVP identifies Erebus as the southernmost active volcano and places it on Ross Island (Erebus L80,L116-L117); its Antarctic catalogue places Erebus among Ross Island volcanoes (L1050), also consistent with BAS L43@P1. The three distractors are genuine Antarctic volcanic features but in distinct settings: Deception Island (L224), Deacon Peak on Penguin Island in the South Shetlands (L223), and Toney Mountain in Marie Byrd Land (L216). Only Erebus matches Ross Island.
literalGroups.locator: GVP Erebus L80,L116-L117; GVP Antarctica L216,L223-L224,L1050; BAS L43@P1

literalGroups.literal: Это Эребус. В его кратере долго существует лавовое озеро.
literalGroups.primaryGround: GVP states the Erebus summit crater contains an active lava lake, with continuous activity documented since 1972 (L116-L117,L667-L668).

literalGroups.literal: Извержения у бухты Телефон на острове Десепшен происходили в 1967, 1969 и 1970 годах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: GVP records eruptions at Telefon Bay on Deception Island in 1967 and 1970, plus a 1969 eruption that destroyed the Chilean base (L224-L225); this is a specific fact about the Deception volcanic island.

literalGroups.literal: Эребус на острове Росса — самый южный действующий вулкан Земли.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained GVP description calls Erebus the world’s southernmost active volcano and locates it on Ross Island (L80,L116), an additional option-specific fact beyond prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: Пик Дикон на острове Пингвин — базальтовый шлаковый конус; рядом расположен кратер Петрен.
literalGroups.primaryGround: GVP identifies Deacon Peak as a basaltic scoria cone on Penguin Island, off King George Island in the South Shetlands; it also describes the nearby Petrel Crater (L223).

literalGroups.literal: Тони-Маунтин — вулканический массив в земле Мэри Бэрд с центральной кальдерой около 2,8 км в диаметре.
literalGroups.primaryGround: GVP locates Toney Mountain in east-central Marie Byrd Land and describes its volcanic massif and central summit caldera, about 2.8 km across (L216).

absoluteDifficulty.audience: Adult player with thematic Antarctic-geography familiarity
absoluteDifficulty.ground: All four answers are volcanic features in Antarctica, so continental elimination no longer identifies the key. The player must distinguish the Ross Island volcano from documented volcanoes at Deception Island, Penguin Island, and Marie Byrd Land. This is thematic geographic recognition, not broad universal knowledge or a specialist multi-step calculation.
